punchline: A psychologist remembered her father reading her a book, then found the first edition was printed a year after he died.
thirty_sec: Carol Tavris was sure her father had read her James Thurber's The Wonderful O. Then she found her first edition: it was printed in 1957, a year after he died. She tells it in a book on self-justification. In Daniel Offer's study, men of forty-eight guessed what they had said as teenagers no better than chance. In surveys, couples' housework shares add up to more than 100 percent.
